cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Dosažení žádoucí úrovně matematických znalostí a dovedností potřebných pro popis fyzikálních a biologických jevů a dějů a jejich matematické modelování. Seznámení se s pojmy nezbytnými pro teoretické zdůvodnění postupů a metod používaných v odborných předmětech a v praxi.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Achieving the level of mathematical knowledge and skills needed for description of physical and biological precesses and their mathematical modeling. Understanding the mathematical concepts that are necessary for justification the methods used in specialized courses and real world problems.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Differential equations and their systems (allowance 10/10) a.Basic concepts and methods for solving differential equationsb.Linear differential equationsc.Applications of differential equationsd.Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of matricese.Autonomous systems of differential equations with applications2.Integral calculus in more variables (allowance 8/8) a.Double integral with applicationsb.Line integral with applicationsc.Green theorem3.Some equations of mathematical physics (allowance 4/4)4.Graph theory (allowance 2/2) a.Basic concepts in graph theoryb.Basic methods in graph theory

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: The course is finished with written exam (90 min.) to detect the level of knowledges and mathematical skills. Both theoretical understanding and ability to compute and solve problems are included in the test. To pass the course, students need to receive at least 40% of the total number of points from the test. Samples of the tests are available to and the content covers the topics from course syllabus.
